subject: VPC / on-prem capability hitlist + staffing proposal
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: VPC/on-prem: capability hitlist + staffing proposal

Aisha / Tessa,

Following the product ask from EdgeCloud (they want a VPC-hosted inference option with a short pilot timeline), I pulled together an initial capability hitlist and a rough FTE ask. Attached: initial_scope.csv (scope buckets and questions).

Topline concerns we need to validate before we commit to any timelines:
- Network/topology: dedicated VPC peering vs. VPN/Transit, expected throughput and egress patterns.
- Data custody & encryption: customer-managed KMS or Redwood KMS? HSM needs?
- Operational runbook: on-call rotations, escalation path for KV cache corruption, backups.
- Compliance evidence: SOC2 artifacts, audit-logs retention policy.

Can you both review the scope and add engineering cost estimates (SRE, infra eng, security review hours) by EOD Monday? I want to synthesize this into a staffing proposal for leadership review.

Karthik
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Attachment: initial_scope.csv (CSV stub - scope, priority, open questions)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-10T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: VPC/on-prem: capability hitlist + staffing proposal

Thanks Karthik — reviewed the CSV. I sketched a pragmatic split for the pilot (short lifecycle, narrow scope) to reduce risk and required headcount. Summary below — will drop the full draft into the Drive folder.

Capability buckets (pilot-focused):
1) Connectivity & Networking (L3): VPC peering, routing, NAT/egress rules, bandwidth expectations. Need partner network diagram and gate for L1 tests.
2) Provisioning & Runtime: IaC templates (Terraform), image signing, runtime config layering (model pinning/versioning), and quantization variant gating.
3) Ops & Observability: on-prem metric export, token-level latency tracing, KV cache warm-up strategy.
4) Security & Compliance: KMS integration option A (customer-managed) / option B (RM-managed), audit log export cadence, penetration test window.

Proposed pilot staffing (high level):
- SRE lead (0.6 FTE for 3 months) — lead onboarding + runbook
- Infra engineer (1.0 FTE for 2 months) — IaC + runtime packaging
- Security engineer (0.2 FTE for 1 month) — KMS + evidence checklist
- Solutions engineer (0.4 FTE ongoing) — customer comms and cutover

If we accept Option A (customer-managed KMS), we reduce internal security effort but increase onboarding time. I recommend we flag both options in the proposal.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-hitlist

Aisha
Senior PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-11T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: VPC/on-prem: capability hitlist + staffing proposal

Thanks Aisha — good split. A few clarifying technical asks before we finalize FTEs: 
- KV cache: for on-prem we need a clear owner for cache invalidation and schema migration; is this the infra engineer role or an SRE duty?
- Runtime packaging: do we need an airgap build (OCI tarball + attestations) for EdgeCloud? If so, add 0.4 FTE build engineering.
- Network: if EdgeCloud insists on cross-account routing, we should factor in a network engineering consult (~40 hrs).

Also, performance question for product: what P95 tail latency SLOs are we committing for their pilot? If low (<=150ms), that materially affects instance sizing and ops complexity.

I'll add the above to the staffing_rationale doc and push a draft.

Karthik

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-11T12:20:00Z
Subject: Re: VPC/on-prem: capability hitlist + staffing proposal

+1 on the items Karthik called out. Quick resource note from Ops: we have two short-term contractors (network architect and build engineer) who could cover the 0.4 FTE airgap/build ask and the 40hr network consult. Hiring wise, to support multiple pilots in Q1 I'd recommend we convert the infra engineer slot to a permanent hire and route the SRE lead as a 6-month interim (we can absorb after).

I've attached a short rationale for leadership (staffing_rationale.pdf) showing cost vs. risk for contractor vs. hire. Also: recommend we scope the pilot SLO at p95 <= 250ms for the first 6 weeks — allows us to validate KV cache heuristics without overprovisioning.

Vivek
VP, Product Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: staffing_rationale.pdf (summary stub)

From: Jamie Park <jamie@edgecloud.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:00:00Z
Subject: Re: VPC/on-prem: capability hitlist + staffing proposal

Aisha / team — thanks for the rapid turnaround. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Timeline: we need a compliance-ready pilot by end of Q1 (target cutover in March).
- KMS: EdgeCloud will prefer customer-managed KMS (we can provide key policy and a test tenant).
- Latency: initial expectation is p95 <= 250ms for inference; we can relax to 350ms during very early stages.
- Network: we'll provide a network diagram and an ASN; expect standard transit with egress controls.

I'll share our SOC2 inventory and networking details. Happy to jump on a short working session if it helps.

Jamie Park
CTO, EdgeCloud, Inc.

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamie Park <jamie@edgecloud.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T15:45:00Z
Subject: Re: VPC/on-prem: capability hitlist + staffing proposal

All — consolidating next steps based on thread: 
1) Scope decision: proceed with customer-managed KMS (EdgeCloud) but document fallback for RM-managed KMS.
2) Pilot SLO: p95 <= 250ms for first 6 weeks; revisit after metrics collection.
3) Staffing: convert infra engineer to perm hire (req posted), SRE lead as 6-month interim, and use contractors for the 0.4 FTE build + network consult.
4) Actions:
   - Karthik: finalize staffing costs and updated timeline (Jira SUP-1894) by 2026-11-16.
   - Tessa: schedule working session with EdgeCloud + security (send invite for next Tue).
   - Grace: prepare SOC2 evidence checklist and confirm retention windows.

I've added the consolidated ask to Jira (SUP-1894) and uploaded the draft scope to Drive. Karthik / Vivek — please review the cost numbers before I present to leadership on Friday.

Thanks,
Aisha
Senior PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
